description: Records that the USER approved spending credits: valid until that total is spent, for up to 6 hours (a whole batch of tracks fits in one yes); generate_sounds, generate_voice, generate_music and sounds_for_folder refuse without it. Call it ONLY after you showed the user the whole plan with the total cost ("Posso gerar <plan> por <total> créditos? Você tem <balance>.") and the user explicitly said yes to THAT cost in their last message. Never call it on your own, never because the user asked for a game or said 'do everything' before seeing the cost. credits = the total the user approved (it replaces any earlier approval).

plan.description: What you asked the user to approve (the events, variations and durations).

user_reply.description: The user's own words saying yes, copied exactly.

name: approve_spending
title: Approve spending credits
